path.description: Memory-repository-relative path of the file that was reviewed, using forward slashes (for example "system/human.md"). The file must exist. Absolute paths, "..", "." and ".git" are refused.

coverage.description: How deeply this turn reviewed the file: "skim" for purpose/pointers/index row, "structure" for frontmatter/headings/links/index placement, "content" for reading the content and checking it against the current facts. Calling this tool is the claim that the review actually happened.

evidence.description: One line (at most 200 characters) naming what was actually checked: the links, index entries, sections or contradictions. Required — it goes into the decay index and the run report, and a mark without evidence is not a review.
